# scripts/automation/Invoke-AvdPowerAction.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Stops, locks or resumes the landing zone's session hosts (auto shutdown, decision 0011).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Action` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-NamePrefix` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-Environment` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  | Required in Automation; in Cloud Shell the current subscription. |
| `-Reason` | string | no | `'manual'` | Why it ran (schedule, budget, manual): recorded on the host pool when locking. |
| `-Force` | bool | no | `$false` | Stop: also deallocate hosts that have user sessions. |
